name: White Desert
source:
She's the girl of his dreams.

White Desert tells the story of Monoe's childhood friend Monoru and explores the deep bond they share together. This tale is not about making choices, but rather about creating an atmosphere and living in the moment.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231127022043/https://renpithy.itch.io/whitedesert]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她是他的梦中情人。

《白色沙漠》讲述了莫诺儿时好友莫诺鲁的故事，并探索了他们之间的深厚纽带。这个故事不是关于做出选择，而是关于营造一种氛围并活在当下。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231127022043/https://renpithy.itch.io/whitedesert]itch.io[/url]]
